method: For each of the 317 days in Step 34, the per-day clock-prediction errors (raw, kernel, net_mean) are propagated through the analytical position-uncertainty model of Step 26 (pos_sigma = sqrt(trace(inv(A^T A + diag(0,0,0,1/sig^2))[:3,:3]))) using representative satellite geometry computed from 52 days of COD0MGXFIN SP3 files, averaged over multiple representative stations at different latitudes (equatorial, mid-latitude, high-latitude, and southern hemisphere) to sample the full geometry distribution a global user would experience.  The GPS constellation repeats with a ~10-day cycle, so the median geometry over 52 days is representative of the full year.  The clock sigmas are the per-day medians of the held-out prediction errors from Step 34 (hyperparameters selected on a different training day).
headline: Position-domain benefit over 318 days (leave-one-day-out, full year 2024): the network kernel reduces 3D position uncertainty by +20% at 4 visible satellites (95% CI [+18, +21]), +26% at 8, and +6% at 3 versus a no-network prior.
